commands.review_summary:
The PR replaces managed Linux code-server and Tailscale curl-to-shell bootstrap installers with pinned checksum-verified archives, updates docs/tests, remaps Tailscale package mode to pinned mode, and edits the changelog.

Reproducibility: yes. for source-level reproduction: current main and v0.33.0 still render the code-server and package-mode Tailscale root installer-script paths. The after-fix runtime path is not fully proven because latest-head managed Linux Code plus Tailscale tailnet readiness has not been shown.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Manual review is needed because full live credential proof and package-mode compatibility acceptance are human-controlled; the narrow Worker chmod defect alone is not enough for a repair lane while proof is insufficient.

target.title: Pin managed Linux bootstrap installers
target.body:
Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/715.

## Summary

- Replace managed Linux Code and Tailscale root `curl | sh` installer pipelines with pinned, checksum-verified archives.
- Install code-server under `/usr/local/lib/code-server` with a stable `/usr/local/bin/code-server` symlink.
- Treat legacy `CRABBOX_TAILSCALE_INSTALL_MODE=package` as pinned static mode; preserving package-mode behavior would require a separate signed-repository implementation.
- Remove downloaded archives and temporary install directories after success while retaining EXIT cleanup on failure.
- Preserve current-main Google Linux signing-key and source-scoped APT hardening.
- Update operator docs and add an Unreleased changelog entry thanking @TurboTheTurtle.

## Verification

Exact head: `82f63284f3c41fa8f7d301d3b39596b3b334fef9`.

- `go test -race ./internal/cli` — pass.
- `go test -race ./internal/cli -run '^TestWindowsWSL2BootstrapCompleteProbeUsesWindowsMarker$' -count=3` — pass; confirms the unrelated full-matrix timeout is load-sensitive.
- `npm run format:check --prefix worker`
- `npm run lint --prefix worker`
- `npm run check --prefix worker`
- `npm test --prefix worker` — 25 files, 710 tests passed.
- `npm run build --prefix worker`
- `scripts/check-docs.sh` — 51 command docs, 68-provider matrix, 201 Markdown files, and docs build passed.
- Downloaded the official code-server 4.126.0 amd64 and Tailscale 1.98.4 amd64 archives; both matched the pinned SHA-256 values.
- Autoreview against `origin/main` — clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
- A first real AWS canary exposed that `cp -a` preserved the private `mktemp` root mode and made code-server non-executable by the lease user. The exact-head fix restores mode `0755` after the copy, with ordering regression coverage and a clean focused autoreview.
- Exact-head AWS canary from binary SHA-256 `60fc8745b73d0f4401fd5f5b7647309609e106561b8812f4e833f6809806be72` — code-server 4.126.0 executed as the lease user, install root mode was `0755`, archive residue was absent, readiness passed, and the disposable EC2 instance and provider key both returned to zero.

## Remaining live gate

Boot one managed Linux canary with Tailscale enabled, verify Tailscale 1.98.4, prove a `100.x` tailnet address, and confirm provider/key/node cleanup. The one-off ephemeral Tailscale credential remains private and is injected only for that validation run.
